full_judgment:
37. The learned Additional Sessions Judge holds the view that only PW 2 Momtaz Begum is the eye-witnesses of the occurrence and there is no corroboration of her evidence. In this respect learned Advocate for the informant petitioner refers section 134 of the Evidence Act which runs thus, "No particular number of witnesses shall in any case be required for the proof of any fact." He submits that no particular number of witnesses is required to prove any case. 

 Section 103: The burden of proof as to any particular fact lies on that person who wishes the court to believe in its existence, unless it is provided by any law that the proof of that fact shall lie on any particular person."
